class.name: robot_hardware_interface/OpenArm_v10HW
class.description: ros2_control hw interface for OpenArm v10 (CAN / CAN-FD via openarm_can when available)

class.name: robot_hardware_interface/HeadHW
class.description: ros2_control hw interface for the OpenArm v2 body's articulated neck (pan/tilt), bridged to the STM32 board via head_motor_driver_node over a Unix Domain Socket.

class.name: robot_hardware_interface/AmazingHandHW
class.description: ros2_control hw interface for the amazing_hand end effector - solves the closed-loop rod/gimbal linkage in-process via amazing_hand_kinematics::HandSolver (no topics, replaces the old topic_based_ros2_control + hand_kinematics_node.py bridge).
